lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 high-contrast vertical lines; spacing is relatively uniform through the mid-torso, narrowing and becoming more irregular toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 9th vertical line (counting from anterior to posterior).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 terminates mid-torso; lines 10, 11, and 12 are fragmented into dashed segments that do not span the full vertical height of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A dense grouping of approximately 8 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower haunch and transition point to the upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A set of three distinct spots aligns horizontally across the mid-thigh, forming a semi-connected geometric pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: White transverse bands present on mid-forelimb and mid-hindlimb; white ocular and muzzle spots visible on the head; prominent dark-and-white dorsal crest.
